target: everyone: shoppers, small sellers and large sellers

actions.action: Extra capacity from Meridian and Dash for 2 weeks
Faster seller payouts (weekly → twice a week) for 6 weeks

message: Your holiday orders are on their way. We have added extra delivery capacity with Meridian and Dash for the next two weeks to keep parcels moving. Sellers: you can move parcels to Meridian and Dash, and for the next six weeks your payouts come twice a week instead of once.
why:
Most Black Friday and Cyber Monday orders ship in week 5, when the Rapid Parcel strike may begin; 40% more room at Meridian and Dash lets sellers move parcels off Rapid Parcel in weeks 5-6.
Sellers stocked up for the holidays and many run on tight cash; paying them twice a week for six weeks keeps them selling through a slow December.
A small ad push keeps shoppers coming back after Cyber Monday; at $1.1M it leaves $1.4M and our second decision for what we cannot see yet.

target: everyone: shoppers, small sellers and large sellers

actions.action: Extra capacity from Meridian and Dash for 2 weeks

message: Rapid Parcel still cannot say when its deliveries will be back to normal, so we are keeping extra delivery capacity with Meridian and Dash for two more weeks. Sellers can keep moving parcels to them. Returns are free until mid-January, so holiday gifts can go back at no cost. We have also added 100 people to our support team: if an order is late, write to us and we will answer within a day.
why:
Rapid Parcel has given no end date for its strike, and the week 5 capacity ends after week 6; in our runs, keeping +40% cut the parcel backlog by about 40% in weeks 7-10.
Late holiday parcels mean worried shoppers: 100 more support staff answer within a day, and in our runs complaints in weeks 7-10 fell by more than half.
Free returns make holiday gifts safe to buy, though our runs show returns rising; both decisions total $2.45M of $2.5M.
